items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: Tom Early, you remember Tom Early, bass player?

ctx.x: Yeah, the Fort Myers, they played around the time I was playing. I didn't know them very well. Cats played with them. They come a little after me, after I quit playing, I think, because I heard of them, and I know Cats played with them. We'll get to ask Cats about them. Yeah, you'd have to ask Cats, but he remembers them, I know.

What about the Rosenmiles? I don't know. Tom Early, you remember Tom Early, bass player? No. He had the Triangle, no, it wasn't a Triangle, what was his name, Harmony, huh? I can't remember Tom Early's band. Raymond worked with him, anyway. And the Rosenmiles.

Oh, who was in Pansy Lane's band? Pansy? Well, the Molos were there again. You had, uh, Molos playing drum. You had, uh, his brother playing trombone. Cats playing drum. No, no, Molos, no, Cats was playing drum. Let's see, who the heck was in that band? Raymond was playing clarinet, when I remember. Uh, I don't know, I can't recall, Dick, but I know Raymond was playing clarinet, Pansy was playing trumpet, Cats was on drums, and I think Molos, well, I better not say, I don't know who was playing trumpet. No. But…
